name: client-request-to-action
title_zh: 客户随口一句「要两千万额度」
tagline_zh: 客户在邮件或聊天里随口一句「额度提到两千万」，你复制粘贴进系统往往漏掉关联的 facility 和产品包。
tagline_en: A client says "they want the line at 20 million" in email or chat. It resolves which product packages and.
desc_en: Guided workflow. Turn a client's ask into a governed nCino action. Takes a request that arrived by email or was spoken in chat ("they want the line at 20 million"), resolves the product package and the facilities it touches, stages a package-anchored loan modification, presents the org's plan and warnings verbatim, waits for the banker's confirmation, executes behind the decision token, and report
why_zh: 关键在「原样呈现 + 等你确认」：它不替你拍板，把机构自己的计划和警告一字不改地摆出来。
why_en: It never decides for you: your org's plan and warnings are shown verbatim, and execution happens only after your confirmation.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 nCino 里的贷款变更这一格：要能解析出产品包和关联 facility，缺了包锚定它直接停下问你。
limit_en: Only covers loan modifications in nCino: it needs a resolvable product package and facilities, and stops to ask if package anchoring is missing. No.
title_en: Turn a client's spoken ask into a governed nCino action
